title: electronic warning and status signal hardware

specimens.name: Red xenon strobe beacon
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Compact standardized red ribbed strobe dome on a low industrial metal/polymer base with internal flash-tube hardware visible only as physical structure; switched off, no glow.

specimens.name: Amber xenon strobe beacon
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Matching amber strobe dome and base from the same standardized family; switched off, no glow.

specimens.name: Clear xenon strobe beacon
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Matching clear/neutral strobe dome on the same low industrial base family; switched off, no flash or glow.

specimens.name: Modular three-color stack light
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Compact standardized cylindrical stack with red, amber and green physical segments on a short gray base, using smaller cleaner late-1990s modules than E1; all segments off.

specimens.name: Paired rectangular red-and-amber LED warning lamps
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Two matching compact rectangular physical LED-array housings on one small standardized bracket, one red and one amber lens; both off, no glow or wiring.

specimens.name: Green hooded LED status lamp
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Compact green LED lens in a standardized dark/gray bezel with a short formed visibility hood; switched off, no label.

specimens.name: Red multi-LED array signal module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One compact rectangular red signal module with a visible regular grid of small physical LED lenses behind a clear cover; all off, no text, arrows or symbols.

specimens.name: Amber multi-LED array signal module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Matching amber signal module from the same family with a regular grid of small physical LED lenses; all off, no text, arrows or symbols.

global_forbidden: text, letters, numbers, arrows, symbols, logos or pseudo-writing
complete beacon towers, runway assemblies, vehicle lighting systems, warning panels, buildings, rooms or scenes
any ninth or extra specimen, duplicate specimen, omitted specimen, merged specimen or substitution
wiring, control panels, screens, complete machines or architecture
motor-driven E1 rotating beacon mechanisms as the dominant signal language, prismatic passive reflectors as major specimens or large sealed floodlights
active light, flashing state, glow, bloom, rays, projected light pools or baked cast/contact shadows
decorative LED strips, modern matrix message boards or E3/E4 architectural lighting
photorealistic product photography, filtered 3D rendering or soft studio lighting

era_contract.character: late-1990s electronic warning/status language replacing motor-driven beacon emphasis with compact xenon strobe families, smaller modular stack hardware and early multi-LED warning arrays
replaced_previous_language: E1 motor-driven rotating warning beacons as the dominant warning technology
larger discrete warning lamps and sealed flood/work lights as primary signal hardware
